physicalNotes: Radius 0.21322189 Jupiter radii from Gomez Barrientos et al. 2025 (2025AJ....170..148G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..148G/abstract): 15,243.7 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.0198 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
